notes: The DM-MD16X16 is a modular, field-configurable 16x16 DigitalMedia matrix chassis with 16 input card slots and 8 dual-output card slots. As shipped (bare chassis), it has NO fixed AV signal connectors (no HDMI/SDI/HDBaseT/etc.) — all actual video/audio/HDBaseT/fiber I/O is provided entirely by separately-purchased, field-installable DMC-series input and output cards (e.g. DMC-4K-HD, DMC-4K-C-DSP, DMC-STR, DMC-VID-RCA-A), each with its own spec sheet and connectors (HDMI, DVI, 3G-SDI, RGB/VGA, component/composite, DM 8G+/HDBaseT RJ45, fiber LC/SC, USB HID, analog audio RCA, etc.). Fixed chassis connectors are: (1) RJ45 LAN (Gigabit), (16) DMNet/EIG terminal-block port-pairs for powering DM CAT devices, (1) IEC C14 power inlet, (1) chassis ground lug screw, and (1) front-panel USB-B console port. Backplane data rate is 12.5 Gbps (not a per-port signal grade, so omitted). Rack size is 7 RU; freestanding mounting is also supported. Data drawn from Crestron's official spec sheet (ss_dm-md16x16_1, revised 03/04/16), cross-checked against crestron.com product page. If modeling this device with populated cards for a signal-flow diagram, the actual AV I/O will depend entirely on which DMC input/output cards are installed and should be sourced from each card's individual spec sheet.
